calls.title: Growthbook <> CIG - Product Meeting
calls.summary: The sales call discussed GrowthBook's open-source experimentation platform, including feature flagging, A/B testing, visual editing, and integration with GA4 and data warehouses. Key pain points included the current internal system being developer-heavy and not user-friendly, with a need for greater autonomy in running experiments. Next steps involve a technical follow-up with Martin, a pricing discussion with Dorine, and a potential trial setup.

Participants: Daniel Wathne (GrowthBook sales/account exec), Logan Bates (GrowthBook technical/solutions), Martin Le Bas (CIG technical lead/architect), Jocelyn Menard (CIG), Emilien Pierru (CIG). Next steps: Martin to discuss with CTO, planned trial starting May 4 (self-hosted or enterprise), set up Teams channel, share documentation, potential use case during upcoming sales event. 

Draft: Daniel Wathne and Logan Bates (GrowthBook) demonstrated the platform to Martin Le Bas, Jocelyn Menard, and Emilien Pierru (CIG), addressing pain points around integrating a centralized feature flagging and experimentation system with CIG's existing badging system across microservices. Key technical concerns included passing user attributes (badge data) to GrowthBook SDKs and self-hosting options for GDPR compliance.
